metadata.description: SkaFld VC: venture capital agents and skills for Claude. Start with SkaFld VC, which needs nothing installed. Add SkaFld VC Files for branded files and exact scoring on your computer (needs Node.js), SkaFld VC Connectors for more data and work tools, and SkaFld VC Platform only if your firm runs a SkaFld VC platform.

plugins.name: skafld-vc
plugins.description: Start here. Sourcing, screening, diligence plans, IC memos and portfolio reviews, with returns, valuation, term sheets, unit economics and cap tables, from your own documents. Exa and Apollo research, and files made with Claude's own Word, PowerPoint, Excel and PDF tools. Needs nothing installed and works with no platform.

plugins.name: skafld-vc-files
plugins.description: Optional, for Claude Code and computers with Node.js 18 or later: SkaFld VC's own branded HTML, Word, PDF, deck and Excel files, brand setup from your website, a firm profile saved across projects, and the rubric scorer as a tool. Installs SkaFld VC with it.

plugins.name: skafld-vc-platform
plugins.displayName: SkaFld VC Platform (for SkaFld platform customers)
plugins.description: Only if your firm runs a SkaFld VC platform: connects SkaFld VC to your firm's pipeline, documents, rubric and house profile, and installs SkaFld VC with it. Asks for your platform's address. No platform? Use SkaFld VC on its own, or contact hello@skafldstudio.com to get one.

plugins.name: skafld-vc-connectors
plugins.description: Optional: more connectors the SkaFld VC agents can read, for people who use them. Paid company data (Crunchbase, PitchBook, CB Insights, Tracxn), more CRMs and note-takers, data rooms, portfolio and finance metrics, public comparables and contracts. Each signs in with your own account.
